index.novos-assets: New assets, content and important changes published in the design system.
colors.a-mesma-base-vai: The same foundation will receive typography, spacing, components and usage guidelines.
colors.o-lumen-ds-sera: Lumen DS will be documented as a living system: simple to consult, consistent to implement.
typography.uma-selecao-de-familias: A selection of families to create contrast, rhythm and clarity in every Lumen experience.
typography.para-titulos-e-mensagens: For titles and messages that need presence without losing clarity.
typography.para-interfaces-navegacao-e: For interfaces, navigation and text that supports frequent tasks.
typography.para-longos-blocos-de: For long blocks of text, data and contexts that call for comfortable reading.
typography.uma-escala-enxuta-para: A lean scale to establish hierarchy without adding noise to the interface.
typography.elementos-semanticos-para-apr: Semantic elements to present information with intention and consistency.
typography.para-titulos-que-guiam: For titles that guide reading and define the subject of an area.
typography.organize-tarefas-acompanhe-de: Organize tasks, track decisions and keep your team aligned at every stage of the work.
typography.para-paragrafos-explicacoes-e: For paragraphs, explanations and continuous reading content.
typography.para-acoes-de-navegacao: For contextual navigation actions within content.
typography.a-entrelinha-acompanha-o: Line height follows the role of the text: compact in titles, comfortable in reading.
typography.projetado-para-impacto-e: Designed for impact and short titles.
typography.equilibrio-para-titulos-de: Balance for titles of two or three lines.
typography.ritmo-confortavel-para-textos: Comfortable rhythm for supporting text, descriptions and larger blocks of content.
iconography.icones-claros-e-reconhecivei: Clear, recognizable icons to guide actions, states and navigation.
iconography.mantenha-o-traco-o: Keep stroke, size and visual meaning consistent across every flow.
iconography.use-16-px-em: Use 16 px in dense fields, 20 px in controls and 24 px in highlighted actions.
iconography.o-icone-herda-a: The icon inherits the color of its context. Reserve semantic colors for states and feedback.
iconography.em-acoes-pouco-familiares: For unfamiliar actions, use a label so the meaning does not depend on the symbol alone.
buttons.acoes-consistentes-para-confirma: Consistent actions to confirm, cancel and guide every flow.
buttons.use-a-hierarquia-visual: Use visual hierarchy to make the primary action clear in every context.
buttons.para-a-proxima-etapa: For the next step or the most important confirmation in the flow.
buttons.para-acoes-importantes-que: For important actions that accompany the primary action.
buttons.para-acoes-complementares-que: For complementary actions that should not compete with the main flow.
buttons.para-remover-cancelar-ou: For removing, canceling or stopping an action with relevant consequences.
buttons.o-estado-desabilitado-comunica: The disabled state communicates unavailability without removing the context of the action.
footer.fundacoes-para-criar-experiencias: Foundations for creating clear and coherent digital experiences.
app.no-tokens: No tokens found. Try another term.
app.no-icons: No icons found. Try another term.
updates.items.icon-library-imported.desc: The Icon component SVGs were added to the system and can now be browsed individually on the iconography page.
updates.items.icon-filters-reorganized.d: The library now separates Type, Outline, Filled and Monochrome, with independent filters and sub-item navigation.
updates.items.button-catalog-published.d: The main button variations of the Design System are now documented on a dedicated page for reference and implementation.
updates.items.color-palette-updated.desc: The palette was synced with Figma: new 950 shades, primary-500 as the primary color (#1678DC) and secondary-950 (#202020). The colors page now lets you copy each token's name and hex value.
